_README: LEDGER for the bookworm -> trixie migration of the emulator-bridge guest base.
The lab HOST is Debian 13 (trixie). The shared bridge guest base is still
Debian 12 (bookworm), and ~29 tiles overlay it read-only. A single flag-day
rebuild is not possible: each tile needs its own overlay rebuild, golden
re-bake and framebuffer acceptance, and several need real per-tile work
So the migration is GRADUAL and this file is its single source of truth.
Each bridge tile declares which suite its overlay is built on. Two bases
coexist; the bookworm one is frozen and is never touched again.
TO MIGRATE A TILE: do the per-tile work, rebuild its overlay against the
trixie base, bake the golden, verify with a real framebuffer screenshot,
and only THEN flip its entry here from "bookworm" to "trixie" in the same
commit. Flipping this file alone changes nothing on the box -- it declares
intent, and scripts/dev/bridge-suite-status.sh fails loudly when the
Consumed by scripts/build-guests/lib/bridge-suite.sh. Not generated: never
run stations-registry.py against it, and do not move it into registry/tiles/.

bookworm._note: FROZEN 2026-07-15. 13 live overlays back onto this byte-for-byte (28 before the migration began). Never rebuild it: `bridge-base.sh --suite bookworm` refuses without --i-know-this-breaks-every-overlay. Count the `tiles` map below rather than trusting this sentence; `scripts/dev/bridge-suite-status.sh` is the authority.

trixie._note: BUILT 2026-08-10, runtime-proven (generic kernel + e1000 + bochs-drm + bare-X kiosk + hatari/EmuTOS on a soltest clone). Matches the host suite, so a host-built binary runs in the guest unchanged and the per-tile ABI chroots stop being necessary. Wave 1 landed atarist/pdp11/gt40 and later decos; wave 2 the MAME tiles bbcmicro/armeval/zx81/dragon32/oricatmos; wave 4 the six VICE tiles c128/vic20/plus4/pet2001/cbm8032/cbm2 -- all 2026-08-10. It now carries live overlays and is frozen IN FACT: the flag below stays false, but bridge-base.sh treats a suite as frozen if the flag is set OR if any tile is declared on it, so the guard armed itself the moment the first tile migrated. Do not hand-flip it.

_notes.mpf2: Wave 2 attempted and rolled back (2026-08-10). Its MAME 0.289 binary is already built in the trixie chroot and its FIRST cold boot under trixie draws the real MPF-II banner and > prompt, so the emulator is fine; the builder's SECOND cold boot then fails its in-guest liveness probe, and its readiness predicate is weak enough to accept a GRUB console. Per-tile work on a soltest clone, not a chroot swap.
_notes.kc854: Wave 2 attempted and rolled back (2026-08-10). Same shape as mpf2: the trixie build reaches a genuine CAOS 4.2 screen (bright 27868, nag-red 0) and then `pgrep -x kc85` finds no MAME after the second cold boot, with SSH proven up first. Per-tile work.
_notes.c64: Its overlay was flattened on 2026-08-07 (a standalone 5.21 GiB qcow2 with an internal `golden` snapshot, no backing file). The status checker reports it as DETACHED rather than as drift; migrating it means a full rebuild, not a rebase.
_notes.openvms: Not on this base. openvms/openvms-decwindows-bridge.qcow2 is built by scripts/build-guests/stages/openvms-decwindows-bridge.sh and only shares /data/vms/bridge/bridge_key. Out of scope for this ledger.
_notes.irix: Not a bridge guest at all: SH_TILE_RUNTIME=x11, MAME on the HOST against a .chd. Already trixie by definition.
